description: Asks to post one message in a team chat conversation you are in, under your name, so everyone in it sees it as yours. Name the conversation by its id (list_chat_conversations gives ids) and write the message exactly as it should appear. Only words: nobody is mentioned. Nothing happens until you approve it in CodeGene: the answer gives a link to the request, which waits there for 15 minutes. Send the person that link; you cannot approve it. Then call get_approval with the requestId to learn how it ended. Once approved, it is posted once; you can delete it in the conversation afterwards, which removes it for everyone.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

text.description: The message, exactly as it will appear under your name.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: post_in_team_chat
